shadow_combo.rule: v9.2 + sell after 3 EMA8 ticks against (not 1) + VIX bounce calls
shadow_combo.ribbon_rule: watch only: 3 contracts when the 5-min EMA 5/8/13/21 ribbon agrees with the trade, else 1

shadow_v95.rule: v9.5 candidate: combo + failed poke B (rejected at green 14, room to VWAP, trap-color days, gives way to trap/gap/fade) + 3 contracts on A trades when your lines agree (green 8 vs red 304; traps: stretched from the reds)

shadow_options.rule: options (live on the card): box · Playbook home run · Tulip v3.2 · turn entry · sniper · calls checkpoint. Card's latest side = direction; agreeing signals as fired; signals against it flipped to the card's side (card's ladder); before the card's first buy only the box; none after the card's 2nd stop; box + Playbook 2 contracts unless flipped.

shadow_hiv.rule: high-IV layer: POP PUT (after 6:50, QQQ $1.50+ over VWAP and +$1.50 in 15 min, IV over 35% at that minute; 25% stop, sell within 40 min) + BELL PUT (6:00->open down 0.15%+ after a red night, IV over 35% at 6:31; 1 contract, 25% stop, breakeven after +50%, hold to 8:56). Skips a pop while the bot holds a call.
shadow_hiv.lean: puts — falling into the bell after a red night

shadow_bigfish.rule: gap vs week (queue #7a): last week down + open $2.50+ above yesterday's close → calls, same entry/exit (big fish wins if both). big fish: setup = (20-day return −8% or worse OR 5-day −3% or worse OR QQQ 20-day vol 26%+) AND gap 1%+; 6:35 close on the gap's side of the open; buy the ~$1.00 0DTE at 6:36 (no IV rule); out on the first 1-min close back across VWAP from 6:40, −35% stop, else 8:56. Skipped if the bell put holds the same side.
shadow_bigfish.note: no setup (no selloff or fear market) · gap vs week: needs QQQ to open $2.50+ above yesterday's close
